mapper.select: SELECT employee.employee_id, employee_version.employee_version_id, employee_version.employee_number, employee_version.display_name AS employee_name, employment.assignment_id AS employment_assignment_id, organization.organization_id, organization_version.organization_version_id, organization_version.name AS organization_name, employee_version.effective_from AS employee_version_from, employee_version.effective_to AS employee_version_to, DATE(employment.effective_from) AS employment_from, DATE(employment.effective_to) AS employment_to, DATE(organization_version.effective_from) AS organization_version_from, DATE(organization_version.effective_to) AS organization_version_to FROM employee employee JOIN employee_version employee_version ON employee_version.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employee_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND employee_version.effective_from < #{periodEndExclusive} AND ( employee_version.effective_to IS NULL OR employee_version.effective_to > #{periodStart} ) JOIN employment_assignment employment ON employment.employee_id = employee.employee_id AND employment.version_valid_to IS NULL AND employment.record_status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATE(employment.effective_from) < #{periodEndExclusive} AND ( employment.effective_to IS NULL OR DATE(employment.effective_to) > #{periodStart} ) JOIN organization_identity organization ON organization.organization_id = employment.organization_id AND organization.company_id = employee.company_id AND organization.identity_status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN organization_version organization_version ON organization_version.organization_id = organization.organization_id AND organization_version.status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATE(organization_version.effective_from) < #{periodEndExclusive} AND ( organization_version.effective_to IS NULL OR DATE(organization_version.effective_to) > #{periodStart} ) WHERE employee.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY employee.employee_id, employee_version.employee_version_id, employment.assignment_id, organization_version.organization_version_id

SELECT event.employee_id, event.point_instant FROM effective_attendance_event event WHERE event.company_id = #{companyId} AND event.event_kind = 'PUNCH_POINT' AND event.point_instant IS NOT NULL AND event.point_instant >= #{windowStart} AND event.point_instant < #{windowEndExclusive} AND ( SELECT lifecycle.lifecycle_type FROM effective_event_lifecycle_fact lifecycle WHERE lifecycle.effective_attendance_event_id = event.effective_attendance_event_id ORDER BY lifecycle.knowledge_at DESC, lifecycle.effective_event_lifecycle_fact_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) = 'ACTIVATED' ORDER BY event.employee_id, event.point_instant

SELECT DISTINCT day.business_date, day.day_type FROM work_calendar calendar JOIN calendar_publication_timeline timeline ON timeline.calendar_publication_timeline_id = ( SELECT latest.calendar_publication_timeline_id FROM calendar_publication_timeline latest WHERE latest.work_calendar_id = calendar.work_calendar_id AND latest.state = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY latest.event_sequence DESC, latest.calendar_publication_timeline_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) JOIN work_calendar_day day ON day.work_calendar_version_id = timeline.work_calendar_version_id AND day.business_date >= #{periodStart} AND day.business_date < #{periodEndExclusive} WHERE calendar.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY day.business_date, day.day_type
